provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Provider id as configured in ~/.config/coding-plans/config.toml, for example claude or zai. One capsule shows one provider; add a second capsule for a second provider.

glyph.label: Icon
glyph.description: Tabler icon name, used only when no brand SVG is found.

show_glyph.label: Show icon
show_glyph.description: The icon beside the reading. Off leaves the percentages alone.

show_name.label: Show provider name
show_name.description: Adds the provider id next to the percentages, so two capsules do not look alike.

refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval
refresh_minutes.description: Minutes between readings. Each capsule runs coding-plans-bar once per interval.

icon_path.label: Icon file
icon_path.description: Path to an icon image. Leave empty to auto-detect the provider's brand SVG shipped with coding-plans-waybar; the icon font is used only if none is found.
